gold_rule: strict = the predicted SNOMED CT code is in the gold code set for that mention; CONCEPT_LESS is correct only against CONCEPT_LESS gold
gold_rule_note: CADEC gold is not always a single code: 252 mentions are post-coordinated (A + B) and 3 are disjunctions (A or B). Scoring 'in the gold set' gives credit for either half of a post-coordinated pair. 2.8% of mentions are affected; report them separately.

corpus.name: CADEC

vocabulary.meddra_note: No independent MedDRA release is available to this project. CADEC ships a meddra_codes.csv derived FROM the corpus, so using it as an existence check would be leakage (the check would accept exactly the answer key). MedDRA is therefore not checked in rung 1 and not scored; SNOMED CT is the only vocabulary gate.

model.note: Owner B fills these in. Judge must be a different model family from the extractor.

rung_order_note: Execution order, not numbering. Rung IDs come from the brief and are identity; renumbering would break comparability with other groups. Abstention runs last because abstaining before correction and voting throws away recoverable records.

1.lexical_mode_note: exact chosen over contained by measurement: contained accepts 19.0% of planted near-miss codes vs 0.1% for exact, buying 11.4pt of ACCEPT-lane coverage. See docs/decisions.md and out/rung1_detection*.json.

2.tau_note: tau is swept on dev only and written here BEFORE the first test run. 0.0 means the confidence gate is off until a real rung-0 confidence distribution exists to calibrate against.
